entities.summary: Melchior Sun Dezhen, C.M. or Melchior Sun Souen (1869–1951) was a Roman Catholic prelate who served as Vicar Apostolic of Anguo (1929–1936), Titular Bishop of Esbus (1926–1951), and Prefect of Lihsien (1924–1926).
